about.title: About the Stellar Crown set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Stellar Crown is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 13 September 2024. It has 175 cards: 142 in the main set and 33 secret rares. For a master set there are also 125 reverse holos, and 17 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 142 main set cards), the Complete set (all 175 cards), the Master set (300 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (317 cards, adding the 17 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
